records.name: ITAV Foundation
records.summary: A volunteer-run nonprofit that supports Philadelphia families with a diaper bank, maternal support and education, and a skin care program. It also serves Jamaica.
records.what_you_do: Call or email the group to ask about volunteering at the diaper bank, becoming a vendor, or joining an upcoming event. Donations go through its PayPal link.

first_step.how: Call 215-512-6465 or email info@itavf.org to ask how to volunteer at the diaper bank or join an upcoming event
first_step.basis: Phone and email are published, but the site does not say how volunteers join or whether events are open to the public.

records.notes: Legal name is Itavfoundation; the site says ITAVFoundation. The home page fetch returned only a page title, so the /about page was read instead. The footer years 2017 to 2026 are not counted as evidence. The /events page returned a 404. The menu lists Upcoming Events but no dates were visible. Maternal support is coded to doula_birth_support as the closest tag. Serves Philadelphia and Jamaica per the site.

records.name: Know Your Worth Girls Inc
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that works with girls ages 8 to 17 on mentoring, money skills and wellness. It holds public events such as skate nights, money workshops and pop-ups.
records.what_you_do: Come to a public event such as a family skate night, a money skills workshop or a pop-up. Ask by email about mentoring, and use the Subscribe option on the Zeffy page to get event notices.

schedule.text: Events several times a year, including a family skate night, money skills workshops and a spring empowerment day. The event list is on the Zeffy page.

first_step.how: Email knowyourworthgirlsinc@gmail.com or use the Subscribe option on the group's Zeffy page to get notice of the next event
first_step.basis: Public events are listed with dates, places and a sign-up for notices, but the page does not say how mentoring places are filled.

records.notes: The group's own site knowyourworthgirlsinc.org failed on two fetches (a TLS error, then a redirect loop), so the facts come from its Zeffy donation page, which lists dated events and the contact email. The Zeffy page says the group has worked since 2019. The newest event with a year is April 5, 2026. Most events on that page are headed Past events and several have no year. Legal name is Know Your Worth Girls, Inc. A news story from the search results could not be opened, so it is not used.

records.name: LUCKY Youth Program
records.summary: A youth organization that pairs young people with mentors for school, leadership and career planning. It also offers educational opportunities, arts and culture activities, and trips.
records.what_you_do: Families or youth can email to request a mentor. People who want to help can email the development team. The site lists leadership, academic and career mentoring tracks.

first_step.how: Email mentoring@luckymp.org to request a mentor, or development@luckymp.org to ask about volunteering
first_step.basis: The email address is published as the way in, but the page does not say what intake or matching involves.

records.notes: Only the home page was readable; /events returned a 404. The awards ceremony is dated June 8th with no year, so it is not counted as evidence. The site lists leadership and academic mentoring for ages 5 to 15 and career path mentoring for ages 16 to 24. The site's Connect with us link leads to a coming-soon page. The acronym expansion on the site is not copied.

records.name: Pamper and Diaper My Baby
records.summary: A nonprofit that stocks diapers and passes them to partner charities that work with families facing emergencies. It runs diaper drives and volunteer work to keep supplies coming.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer through the Heart 2 Heart page, join a diaper drive, or follow the group's Instagram for pop-up events. Diapers go to partner nonprofits, not to individual families.

first_step.how: Open the Heart 2 Heart Volunteer page at padmb.org/volunteer or use the Contact Us page to ask how to help
first_step.basis: The volunteer page is linked, but the site does not explain how to sign up or when volunteers are needed.

records.notes: The footer year 2025 is not counted as evidence. The events page lists no dated items and points to social media for pop-up events, so the status is probably_active from the working site. Individual families cannot receive diapers from the group. The Contact Us page was not opened, and no email or phone is published on the pages read.

first_step.basis: Programs are listed, but the pages read do not give sign-up steps, age ranges or dates.

No email, phone or street address is published on the pages read, and no dated items were found. The site has a donation link and an Instagram handle (@pyfa215).

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used (cap reached). Fetches: 26 used. Errors were domain, connection and 404 errors, not a rate limit or bot check. Verdicts: 12 publish, 3 hide (Limitless Ladies CDC placeholder site, Miller Guidepost partner-only, Reach to Your Youth Mentor Project dead domain).
